packages.title: A project that's gone shows read-only again; round 2 re-checked
brief: Context: in b9 round 2, P114 fixed UX-626 by computing the project page's `readOnly` from the project it looked up: `final readOnly = widget.listId != null && list != null && !list.canEdit;` (App/lib/screens/home_screen.dart:282, comment at :279-281). Reviewer C found all five round-2 findings fixed in code (verify-b9-r2-C.md), but found one new edge case, UX-630 (R2C-1, S1). It is caused by that same line. Only home_screen.dart changes in this package (plus the one test the change rightly breaks). UX-625, UX-626, UX-629, UX-627 and UX-628 are listed so the reviewer re-checks them this round. Keep them exactly as they are: no change to their code.

What went wrong (UX-630): `list == null` now always makes `readOnly` false, even after the lists have finished loading. If the project is still missing from `taskListsProvider` after it settles (the user was removed from a shared project, or the project was deleted on another device while its page stayed open), the page shows `Añadir tarea` and the empty state `Añade una tarea a este proyecto. Tú eliges la fecha y el recordatorio.` under the fallback title `Proyecto`. But `TaskActions` gets `projectId: null` (:522-527), because `listCanEditProvider` is false for an unknown id. So the new task is saved outside the project and never appears on the page.

Fix (reviewer C's main option; don't build the alternative of popping the page): treat an unknown project as 'not known yet' only while the lists are loading. At home_screen.dart:263-265, watch the provider once and reuse it for the lookup: `final lists = ref.watch(taskListsProvider);` and `final list = (lists.valueOrNull ?? []).where((list) => list.id == widget.listId).firstOrNull;`. Then at :282: `final readOnly = widget.listId != null && (list == null ? !lists.isLoading && lists.hasValue : !list.canEdit);`. Rewrite the comment above it to say: a project the user can only view, or one that's gone, gets the read-only bar; while the lists are still loading, an unknown project just isn't known yet, so a new one doesn't flash as read-only. Why this still covers UX-626: `editTaskList` (App/lib/screens/task_lists_screen.dart, :572-580) calls `store.create`, then `ref.invalidate(taskListsProvider)`, then returns. `createProject` (:416-430) pushes the page after that, so the new page first sees the lists reloading (`isLoading` true, with the previous value), and the reload then returns the new project.

Effects you don't need to code: once `readOnly` is true for a gone project, the existing branches already show the read-only ListTile (`Este proyecto es de solo lectura` / `El propietario del proyecto gestiona los permisos de edición.`) instead of `TaskActions`, and the empty state `Este proyecto aún no tiene tareas.` (`readOnlyListEmpty`, P114's order at :471-479). No copy change and no ARB change in this package.

Test the change rightly breaks: App/test/home_screen_test.dart, the test 'UX-626: a new project not yet in the lists never shows Este proyecto es de solo lectura…' (about :742). It starts with the lists *settled* without `p1` and expects no read-only line. That settled state is now UX-630's, and it must show the read-only line. Change only the test's starting state, so it matches the real new-project moment: `taskListsProvider` is reloading (it has a previous value without `p1`, and the new future isn't complete yet, for example a Completer the test completes). Keep its assertions: no read-only line on any frame of the reload, then `Añadir tarea` and the title `Obra` once `p1` arrives as editable. Keep every other test in the file as it is. ux-tester writes the new acceptance tests.

Don't touch: `listCanEditProvider` and App/lib/providers/task_lists_provider.dart; App/lib/screens/task_lists_screen.dart (`createProject` keeps pushing at once); the `TaskActions` branch; the empty-state order and the `filtering` rule (UX-625, UX-629); the read-only ListTile's copy and layout; `ProjectScopeControl`; App/lib/screens/groups_screen.dart and App/lib/screens/activity_screen.dart (UX-627, UX-628, already fixed); every ARB file.

Known limit, accepted: `taskListsProvider` rebuilds whenever `taskProvider` reloads. So on a gone project's page, the bottom bar can show `Añadir tarea` for the moment of each reload, and then go back to read-only. Don't add state to hide this. The page is rare, and the window is a local read.
acceptance: Widget test (home_screen_test.dart, UX-630): in Spanish at 1× on 360×740, a project page (`HomeScreen(isRoot: false, listId: 'p1')`) whose `taskListsProvider` has settled (not loading) without `p1` shows `Este proyecto es de solo lectura` and `Este proyecto aún no tiene tareas.`, and shows no `Añadir tarea`, no `TaskActions` and no `Añade una tarea a este proyecto. Tú eliges la fecha y el recordatorio.`

Widget test (UX-630): in Spanish, a project page opened while `p1` is in the lists as editable shows `Añadir tarea`. After the provider is invalidated and settles without `p1` (the user was removed), the page shows `Este proyecto es de solo lectura` and no `Añadir tarea`.

Widget test (UX-626): in Spanish, a project page opened while `taskListsProvider` is reloading (previous value without `p1`, new future pending) shows no `Este proyecto es de solo lectura` and no `Este proyecto aún no tiene tareas.` on any pumped frame. When the reload completes with `p1` editable, it shows `Añadir tarea`, the app-bar title `Obra`, and still no read-only line.

Widget test (UX-630): at 2× text on 320×568, in Catalan, the settled-without-`p1` page shows `Aquest projecte és de només lectura` and `Aquest projecte encara no té tasques.` with no overflow error, and no `Afegeix una tasca`.

Widget test: the existing P114 and P115 tests still pass unchanged: UX-625 (view-only empty project says `Este proyecto aún no tiene tareas.`; an editable one says `Añade una tarea a este proyecto…` with `Añadir tarea`), UX-629 (`Para mí` with nothing for the user says `No hay tareas que coincidan`), UX-627 (groups_screen_test.dart: the role shows only in the user's own member row), UX-628 (activity_screen_test.dart: the Activity screen is titled `Actividad del grupo` / `Group activity` / `Activitat del grup`).

Code: home_screen.dart watches `taskListsProvider` once for the lookup, and `readOnly` is `widget.listId != null && (list == null ? !lists.isLoading && lists.hasValue : !list.canEdit)`; `listCanEditProvider` and the `TaskActions` branch are unchanged; `git diff` touches no ARB, groups_screen.dart or activity_screen.dart.
deviceChecks: On an Android phone, create a project from Proyectos (`Nuevo proyecto`, type a name, save) and watch the bottom of the new page during the transition: `Añadir tarea` shows, and `Este proyecto es de solo lectura` never flashes. (UX-626; inferred from code by reviewer C.)

With two accounts (phone or emulator for the second), open a shared project on the first account. Remove that account from the project on the second, then pull to refresh on the first account's project page (or wait for sync). The page shows `Este proyecto es de solo lectura` and no `Añadir tarea`. (UX-630; inferred from code, rare.)
